findings.title: Homepage absent from page-1 non-personalised web results for 'visaprepper' (indexed, Google canonical = declared; brand-ranking issue)
findings.description: Brand SERP 2026-11-21: in a clean built-in browser (google.com, hl=en, gl=us, pws=0, IP country unknown) page 1 for 'visaprepper' listed /terms first, then /features, /partners, Instagram @visaprepper, visapro.com, /pricing, vispera.co and a Google Play app 'VisaPrepAI: US Visa Prep'; the homepage appeared only in the Images strip. The same day, in the owner's signed-in Chrome, the homepage ranked #1 (personalised). Built-in-browser checks for gl=in (auto-corrected to 'visa prepper', /partners first), gl=pk and gl=ng (/contact first) also showed the homepage only in the Images strip. For the quoted query "visa prepper" the homepage ranked last on page 1 with a Google-rewritten title link 'Visa Prepper'. Search Console 2026-11-21 (evidence/gsc/README.md, pages-2026-11-21.csv): URL Inspection of https://visaprepper.com/ shows it indexed, last crawled Nov 21, 2026 09:55 by Googlebot smartphone, with the Google-selected canonical equal to the declared https://visaprepper.com/ and an earlier indexing request on record. From 2026-09-05 to 2026-11-19 the homepage had 7 clicks, 107 impressions, CTR 6.5% and average position 3.9, the most clicks of any URL. Its queries are mostly anonymized: the 109 reported queries account for 1 click and none contains 'visaprepper' or 'visa prepper'; the brand regex visa\s?prep|prepper|visaper|visaprep returns 0 clicks and 16 impressions (position 4.9). The http and www homepage variants are 'Page with redirect'. On-page signals verified healthy 2026-11-21 11:36-11:41 UTC: HTTP 200, server-rendered (raw 5,755 vs rendered 5,754 words), self canonical https://visaprepper.com, brand-first 60-char title 'VisaPrepper | U.S. Visa Interview Practice & Document Checks' (live at audit time), no meta robots or X-Robots-Tag, byte-identical body for a Googlebot UA, WebSite and Organization JSON-LD name 'VisaPrepper' with alternateName ['Visa Prepper', 'visaprepper.com']. Context: the H1 'Your U.S. visa interview starts with better preparation.' has no brand; the homepage has about 5,640 main-content words with 9 brand mentions (0.16%) versus /terms 789 words with 11 (1.4%). WHOIS: domain created 2026-09-06 (76 days old). The homepage was edited twice on 2026-11-04 and twice on 2026-11-18. What Search Console settles and what it does not: it settles indexing and canonicalisation: the homepage is indexed and Google uses the declared canonical, so this is not an indexing problem. It does not settle the rank for 'visaprepper': the homepage's 107 impressions at average position 3.9 come from mostly anonymized queries, and an average over all of the homepage's queries is compatible with it missing page 1 for the single bare-brand query. The two brand SERP readings differ because the owner's signed-in Chrome is personalised; the clean-browser miss is the reading that matters for new searchers. Both are recorded. Hypotheses revised with Search Console: (1) canonical-host split (TECH-02, TECH-03): largely ruled out for the homepage, because Google indexed the apex and kept the declared canonical and the www/http variants are reported as redirects; the vercel.app host is outside the Domain property, so its index state is unknown. (2) New domain and an ambiguous one-word brand token: most likely remaining cause (76-day-old domain, auto-correction to 'visa prepper' in gl=in, look-alike results, only 16 brand-like impressions in 11 weeks); non-personalised results rank pages by term match, while the owner's personalised results put the homepage first. (3) Topic dilution and an H1 without the brand: still possible; fixing it is a visible content change (not allowed); M001 now puts both spellings in the homepage title (working tree, not deployed). (4) Re-processing after repeated edits: weaker, since the homepage was recrawled on Nov 21, 2026 and is indexed. (5) Conflicting brand signals from the app subdomain: stronger than before, since app.visaprepper.com/ and /signup are indexed with 'VisaPrep ... Pakistan, India, and Bangladesh' shell metadata (TECH-04). Measurement limit: brand-query volume is tiny and mostly anonymized, so Search Console cannot show the homepage's position for 'visaprepper' itself. The pages that rank in the clean brand SERP (/terms, /features, /partners, /contact, /pricing) also show small impression counts at average positions 3.4-6.4 with anonymized queries, which fits brand or navigational searches but does not prove it. Dated clean-browser checks remain the measure; record a personalised reading next to each one.
findings.recommendation: Do not request indexing for / again (it is indexed with the declared canonical and a request is already on record). Owner: ship H01 and H02 (TECH-02, TECH-03) and H04 (TECH-04); deploy the metadata batch including M001 and M002 and record the deploy date. 2-4 weeks after the deploy, repeat the clean-browser 'visaprepper' check (gl=us, in, pk, ng) next to a personalised reading, and compare the homepage's Search Console row with the baseline (7 clicks, 107 impressions, position 3.9). Keep the brand-first title; keep the /contact, /partners and /partners/apply titles (M007, M017, M019) and the held /features title (M011) until the homepage ranks. Changing the H1 or copy is a visible content change and not allowed now.
